```javascript
import path from 'node:path';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
const DATA_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, 'data');

const TOOLS = [
  {
    name: 'file_metadata',
    description: 'Return metadata about a file in the data directory.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        path: { type: 'string', description: 'Path relative to the data directory.' }
      },
      required: ['path'],
      additionalProperties: false
    }
  }
];

export async function listTools() {
  return TOOLS;
}

function isString(v) {
  return typeof v === 'string';
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'file_metadata') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  if (!args || typeof args !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments');
  }
  const { path: relPath } = args;
  if (!isString(relPath) || relPath.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('path must be a non-empty string');
  }
  if (relPath.includes('\0')) {
    throw new Error('Invalid path');
  }
  const resolved = path.resolve(DATA_DIR, relPath);
  const dataWithSep = DATA_DIR.endsWith(path.sep) ? DATA_DIR : DATA_DIR + path.sep;
  if (resolved !== DATA_DIR && !resolved.startsWith(dataWithSep)) {
    throw new Error('Path traversal not allowed');
  }
  let stat;
  try {
    stat = await fs.stat(resolved);
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Error('File not found');
  }
  if (!stat.isFile()) {
    throw new Error('Not a file');
  }
  const rel = path.relative(DATA_DIR, resolved).split(path.sep).join('/');
  const ext = path.extname(rel).toLowerCase();
  const text = `path: ${rel}\nsize: ${stat.size}\nextension: ${ext}`;
  return { content: [{ type: 'text', text }] };
}
```
